verdict.rationale: SumUp's API is inherently headless: static API keys with Bearer auth (sumup-docs-14, sumup-docs-37), a JS SDK usable in modern runtimes (sumup-docs-27), and sandbox merchant accounts/test cards designed for automated testing of payment flows (sumup-docs-17, sumup-docs-1) all support scripted, non-interactive use suitable for CI. However, there is no explicit documentation of a CI/CD pipeline example, headless CLI, or automated test harness. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guide, dedicated CLI/headless mode, and independent evidence of running SumUp flows inside automated pipelines.
